--- original

@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: 'Add SubagentSessionTable: child run to ACP child session id and parent link'
+---
+## What
+Make one table per ACP session. It maps each agent run of the `agents` tool to one ACP child `SessionId`, and it keeps the parent `SessionId`, the depth, and a flag that tells if the announcement was sent. The table is the base for all other subagent tasks.
+
+New file: `Sources/FoundationModelsACPAgent/Agent/SubagentSessionTable.swift`. Use a `Mutex`, as `RunCallJoinTable` does, because the run event observer calls it from synchronous code.
+
+Rules (from the ACP subagents RFD):
+- A child id is opaque, unique on the connection, and never reused for an other run.
+- A child has one parent. The table refuses a self parent, a cycle, and a change of parent.
+- The parent of a depth 1 run is the root ACP session. The parent of a nested run is the child id of the run that started it.
+- The table gives the full ancestor chain, parent first.
+
+Read the parent link from `AgentRun.caller` and `AgentRun.depth` (public) and from the Router `RouterSessionDirectory` entry (`kind: .subagent`, `parentID`). If a needed field is not public in FoundationModelsAgents, write down the gap in the task comment. Do NOT change FoundationModelsAgents or FoundationModelsRouter from this task (a change there needs its own card, discussed first).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `SubagentSessionTable.childId(for: runID)` gives the same id on each call and a different id for each run.
+- [ ] A cycle, a self parent, and a second parent for one child each throw a typed error.
+- [ ] `ancestors(of:)` gives the chain parent first, for a depth 3 nesting.
+- [ ] The table is owned by the session surface, next to `runCallJoins`, and it lives as long as the session.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsACPAgentTests/SubagentSessionTableTests.swift`: id stability, cycle refusal, ancestor order, concurrent access.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter SubagentSessionTableTests`. All pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #subagents
\ No newline at end of file
